mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date , SUM(price) AS totalPrice FROM orders WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND order_status IN ('SUCCESS', #{status}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y%m%d')

SELECT O.order_id, O.store_id, O.price, O.order_status, O.ordered_at, P.place_name, P.place_id, M.menu_id FROM orders O JOIN order_menus OM ON O.order_id = OM.order_id JOIN places P ON O.place_id = P.place_id JOIN menus M ON OM.menu_id = M.menu_id WHERE O.store_id = #{storeId} AND O.order_status IN ('SUCCESS', #{status}) AND DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{date}
SELECT ROUND((SUM(price) / COUNT(*)), 2) AS averageValue FROM orders WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND order_status = 'SUCCESS'
